content: The Kindle Scribe is worth considering if you’re heading back to school, as its large 10.2-inch screen can display textbooks and ebooks, or let you jot down handwritten notes during class. Now through August 8th, the first-gen model (with a Premium Pen) is down to just $149.99 with 16GB of storage in refurbished condition at Woot when you apply the promo code KINDLE25 at checkout. That’s $220 off its original launch price from 2022 and even cheaper than the current Kindle Paperwhite, though you’ll only get Woot’s 90-day warranty. Woot doesn’t specify the exact condition of its refurbished devices, but it does offer a brief explanation here of what to expect. [Product: Kindle Scribe (16GB) | https://www.anrdoezrs.net/links/8836598/type/dlg/https://computers.woot.com/offers/amazon-kindle-scribe-43] The Kindle Scribe features a sharp 300ppi E Ink display that’s glare-free and supports adjustable color temperatures, making it easy to read whether you’re outside in the sun or studying late at night. Like all other Kindles, the Scribe gives you quick and easy access to Amazon’s massive store of digital books, so you can switch between assigned reading and your favorite novels without carrying multiple books or devices. It’s not waterproof like the Kindle Paperwhite, though, so you’ll want to keep it away from the pool and be careful when it rains. It’s also a solid digital notebook, with the device offering a variety of pre-made templates for everything from lined paper and planners to to-do lists. After updating the software, the original Kindle Scribe also includes the same AI-powered note-taking features as the newer models, allowing you to jot down notes directly on compatible ebook pages, summarize and refine your handwritten notes, generate AI-powered summaries, and more. Read our Kindle Scribe (2022) review.
chineseTitle: 第一代 Kindle Scribe 是一款大型电子阅读器和数字笔记本，翻新价格为 150 美元
chineseSummary: 如果您要返回学校，Kindle Scribe 值得考虑，因为它的 10.2 英寸大屏幕可以显示教科书和电子书，或者让您在课堂上记下手写笔记。从现在到 8 月 8 日，第一代型号（配有高级笔）翻新后 16GB 存储的售价仅为 149.99 美元 [...]
chineseContent: 如果您要返回学校，Kindle Scribe 值得考虑，因为它的 10.2 英寸大屏幕可以显示教科书和电子书，或者让您在课堂上记下手写笔记。即日起至 8 月 8 日，当您在结帐时使用促销代码 KINDLE25 时，第一代型号（配有高级笔）在 Woot 上的翻新状态（带 16GB 存储空间）仅需 149.99 美元。这比 2022 年的原始发布价格低了 220 美元，甚至比当前的 Kindle Paperwhite 还要便宜，不过你只能获得 Woot 的 90 天保修。 Woot 没有具体说明其翻新设备的具体状况，但它确实在此提供了有关预期结果的简要说明。 [产品：Kindle Scribe (16GB) | https://www.anrdoezrs.net/links/8836598/type/dlg/https://computers.woot.com/offers/amazon-kindle-scribe-43] Kindle Scribe 配备清晰的 300ppi 电子墨水显示屏，无眩光，支持可调节色温，无论您是在阳光下还是在深夜学习，都可以轻松阅读。与所有其他 Kindle 一样，Scribe 可让您快速轻松地访问亚马逊海量数字图书商店，因此您可以在指定阅读和您最喜欢的小说之间切换，而无需携带多本书或设备。不过，它不像 Kindle Paperwhite 那样防水，因此您需要将其远离游泳池，并在下雨时小心。它也是一款可靠的数字笔记本，该设备提供各种预制模板，适用于从横格纸和计划表到待办事项列表的所有内容。更新软件后，原版 Kindle Scribe 还包含与新型号相同的人工智能笔记功能，让您可以直接在兼容的电子书页面上记下笔记、总结和完善手写笔记、生成人工智能摘要等等。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
